displayName: [Preview]: Azure SQL Database failover groups should use allowed partner locations
description: Keep Azure SQL Database failover-group partners within approved regions to help meet data residency requirements. Only configured partner server locations are evaluated; database default secondary locations, standalone active geo-replication links, and backup locations are not evaluated.

metadata.description: The list of Azure regions where Azure SQL Database failover-group partner servers are allowed.
Enable or disable the execution of the policy
